S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2

V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L_=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n");cols=L_[0].split()
AAi={a:i for i,a in enumerate(cols)}
S=np.full((25,25),-4.0)
for ln in L_[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): S[AAi[p[0]],AAi[c]]=int(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([AAi.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def nw_fast(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        row = S[e1[i-1], e2] if e1[i-1]>=0 else np.full(m,-4.0)
        prev=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1],Y[i-1,:-1]])
        am=prev.argmax(0);best=prev.max(0)
        M[i,1:]=best+row;pM[i,1:]=am
        u=M[i-1,1:]+go;v=X[i-1,1:]+ge
        X[i,1:]=np.maximum(u,v);pX[i,1:]=np.where(u>=v,0,1)
        # Y row (left-dependency) must be sequential
        yi=Y[i];mi=M[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=mi[j-1]+go;b=yi[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b: yi[j]=a;pY[i,j]=0
            else: yi[j]=b;pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m;state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if state==0:A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;state=ns
        elif state==1:A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;state=ns
        else:A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;state=ns
        if i==0 and j>0:state=2
        if j==0 and i>0:state=1
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2))

def upjson(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()
def domain_slice(a, flank=80):
    d=upjson(a); s=d["sequence"]["value"]
    dom=[(f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in d.get("features",[])
         if f["type"]=="Domain" and "Aminotran" in str(f.get("description",""))]
    if not dom: return None
    st,en=dom[0]
    return s[max(0,st-1-flank):min(len(s),en+flank)]

G5=upjson("G5EE32")["sequence"]["value"]; QOFF=3049; REF=G5[QOFF:3460]
ORTH=[("A0A8S1EER0","C. bovis"),("A0A8R1HKF0","C. japonica"),("E3LPQ4","C. remanei"),
      ("A0A2G5TH38","C. nigoni"),("A8Y4A6","C. briggsae"),("G0NH17","C. brenneri"),
      ("A0A261BYQ5","C. latens"),("A0A1I7T5F4","C. tropicalis"),("A0AAF3FQ74","M. belari"),
      ("A0A2A6C9Z9","P. pacificus"),("A0A811L5Z8","B. okinawaensis"),("A0A914CA45","A. nanus"),
      ("A0AA39HPG9","S. hermaphroditum"),("A0AAD4N8D7","D. destructor")]
KEY={3171:"re-face (apple Y145)",3227:"NPxxPLG loop (apple N202)",3255:"pyridinium N1 (apple D230)",
     3257:"si-face (apple I232)",3258:"PLP 3-OH (apple Y233)",3291:"phosphate cup (apple S270)",
     3293:"phosphate cup (apple S272)",3294:"Schiff base (apple K273)",3302:"phosphate Arg pos (apple R281)",
     3427:"substrate COO- (apple R407)",3145:"Gly-loop (apple G119)",3146:"Gly-loop (apple A120)",
     3147:"Gly-loop (apple T121)",3150:"Gly-loop (apple N124)",3111:"cross-subunit (apple Q83*)",
     3113:"cross-subunit (apple Y85*)",3322:"cross-subunit (apple S301*)",3323:"cross-subunit (apple F302*)"}
out={k:[] for k in KEY}; names=[]
for acc,sp in ORTH:
    sl=domain_slice(acc)
    if sl is None: print(sp,"no domain annotation; skipped"); continue
    a1,a2=nw_fast(REF,sl)
    i=QOFF;m={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1; m[i]=c2
    idn=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-'); al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    names.append(sp)
    for k in KEY: out[k].append(m.get(k,'-'))
    print(f"{sp:<20} {acc:<12} {100*idn/al:5.1f}% identity over {al} aligned domain columns")

df=pd.DataFrame(out,index=names).T
df.index=[f"{G5[k-1]}{k}" for k in KEY]
df.insert(0,"role",[KEY[k] for k in KEY])
df["frac_identical"]=np.round([(df.loc[l,names]==l[0]).mean() for l in df.index],2)
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print("\n### Residue at each functionally assigned position across nematode orthologs")
print(df.to_string())
df.to_csv("nematode_conservation_at_PLP_site.csv")
grp={"same-chain PLP contact":[3171,3227,3255,3257,3258,3291,3293,3294,3302],"substrate contact":[3427],
     "Gly-rich loop (uncertain alignment)":[3145,3146,3147,3150],"cross-subunit interface":[3111,3113,3322,3323]}
print("\n### Mean conservation by class")
rows=[]
for g,ks in grp.items():
    v=[df.loc[f"{G5[k-1]}{k}","frac_identical"] for k in ks]
    rows.append((g,len(ks),round(float(np.mean(v)),2))); print(f"  {g:<38} n={len(ks)}  mean = {np.mean(v):.2f}")
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["class","n","mean_frac_identical"]).to_csv("conservation_by_class.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,5.8))
order=[k for g in grp for k in grp[g]]; labels=[f"{G5[k-1]}{k}" for k in order]
cm={"same-chain PLP contact":"#2a7f62","substrate contact":"#5b9bd5","Gly-rich loop (uncertain alignment)":"#e0a33e","cross-subunit interface":"#c4462f"}
colors=[cm[g] for g in grp for k in grp[g]]
ax.bar(range(len(order)),[df.loc[l,"frac_identical"] for l in labels],color=colors)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order)));ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=60,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(f"fraction of {len(names)} nematode orthologs identical to T04F3.1");ax.set_ylim(0,1.05)
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color=c,label=l) for l,c in cm.items()],fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc="lower left")
